note: He is not a draft target in our 144-player auction. Yahoo ranks him 404 and ESPN ranks him 237, both value him at 0 USD, and he went for 2 USD in our league's last auction. Yahoo projects only 25 games and 9.3 points per game, with very weak rebounds and steals. He scored 22.5 points on 18 shots per game in 2023-24, but last season he fell to 13.5 points in 21 minutes. An expert also warns that hype inflates his value. Early in the season, check whether he signs with a team and what role he gets before you spend any FAB on him.
